about: Reference trays for the NotebookLM comparison (Vozonda docs/plan-multisource-tray.md section 6). Public sources only, so nothing private goes to Google. Notes are given word for word; screenshots are made by make_screenshots.py.

sources.text: Background for the hosts: the listener builds small tools at home and wants to know why attention made recurrent networks obsolete, and what the paper itself says it did not solve.

sources.note: 38k words: far over the budget, so it exercises condensing

sources.text: Question for the hosts: does running a 35B model at home really beat a cloud API on cost once the hardware is paid off, and what do the numbers leave out (noise, time, model quality, privacy)?
